method: Root test/ui was renamed test/surfaces after classification (it holds UI faces mounted against the real server and assembled app; the UI-only suites are in apps/ui/test). Static reach analysis of every root *.test.mjs at the baseline commit: imports (resolved through test/support and sibling helpers), repository path literals read, and child-process use; aof/default-application and its service entries count as the assembled application. A file is moved only when everything it reaches is one workspace plus that workspace's declared dependencies, it imports no arch guard or shared root helper, and it reads no repository-level artifact. Verdicts were checked by running each destination workspace's own suite and by comparing the registered case-name multiset (11,537, no duplicates) before and after every batch. Each entry records its registered case count and the SHA-256 of its sorted case names (newline-joined), from importing the file at its current path; the names themselves are not stored here, because test names carry fixture source paths that the wiki citation sweep would read as citations. Recompute by importing the file at the recorded revision.

assembledApplicationEvidence.wiring: packages/core/src/application/assemble.mjs builds each namespace from package factories (for example createMeshPresence in @aof/mesh/presence) with collaborators supplied by core bindings under packages/core/src/application/bindings/. Moving one of these suites to a package means constructing that collaborator graph by hand per suite; a suite that executes one feature package is package-owned in principle, and the open ones are named in the ledger (`reason` starting `executes exactly one feature package`).
assembledApplicationEvidence.measurement: Each suite outside the command surface was run alone under V8 coverage (NODE_V8_COVERAGE, precise function counts) and compared with an assembly-only baseline (importing aof/default-application, three runs, maximum count per function); a function counts as executed by the suite when its call count exceeds the baseline. The packages whose src functions the suite executed are recorded per entry as `measured`, with the number of functions. A static walk of core's assembly graph over-approximates (it counts every collaborator a binding is handed), so it is not used as evidence.
